description: The page's own: skip names for now in the selected environment (`skip: false` undoes it). A skipped name gets an empty value in the run here and no LOCAL_VARIABLE_UNSET; EMPTY_DEFAULT_VARIABLE turns to info; SECRET_MISSING stays a block. Agents never call it.

request_schema.description: `iii-cloud::values::skip` input: the page's own. Names only.

environment_id.description: The selected environment, as a guard (`ENVIRONMENT_CHANGED`).

request_schema.title: ValuesSkip

response_schema.description: The environment's skipped names after `iii-cloud::values::skip`, sorted.
response_schema.title: ValuesSkipped
